nodes.title: Slot 3 Custom: USE skip / local / api 1 / api 2
How to use
widgets_values:
DETAIL FIXER: fix anything in a generated photo
1. Load your photo in "Your photo" (top left).
2. Each slot finds something with SAM 3 (the "find" text boxes), crops it at high resolution, regenerates only that area, and blends it back. Slots run in order: Logo > Face > Custom.
3. In each slot, the "USE" node picks the result: skip / local (Qwen, free, your GPU) / api 1 (Nano Banana 2) / api 2 (GPT Image 2). Only the chosen one runs, so API credits are only spent when you pick an API (sign in to Comfy.org under Settings > User).
4. Queue. The result is saved to output/DetailFixer.

Per slot
- Logo: load your logo twice (reference image + transparent PNG guide). Edit the prompt if the logo isn't on a t-shirt. Strength (denoise) 0.7-0.8.
- Face: gentle fix, strength 0.35-0.45, colour matched to the original skin. Add a reference photo of the person as image2 if you need identity locked.
- Custom: type what to find ("hand", "jeans", "shoe", "watch") and what to do. Set USE to local.

Tips: higher strength = more change. Try another seed if a result is off. "Work at 2x" upscales the photo first so small details get enough pixels (output is 2x).
